name: Driving feedback
about: Record a specific road or wheel-feel comparison
title: "[Driving] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Car and route
Game build, vehicle/configuration, road/terrain and approximate speeds:

## ACNG setup
Preset, selected effects, tire temperatures/pressures if available:

## The comparison
Start from a fresh reset for each run. Compare the same maneuver with master OFF
and ON. What changed? Cold grip, warm grip, braking, cooling, wheel weight or clipping?

## One targeted observation
For example: cold tires feel too slippery/about right/barely different, or steering
gets too light/heavy as the front tires slide. Include the conditions that caused it.

## Measurement or confidence
Telemetry/timing if available. Label subjective impressions as impressions; do not
claim measured real-tire or Assetto Corsa equivalence without reference evidence.
